name: org_graph_set_kind_parents
description: Set which unit types a unit type can sit under (parent_ids, other level_ids in the taxonomy; list the type itself to let it nest) and whether it can sit at the top, from effective_on (today by default). parent_ids replaces the whole list. A type needs somewhere to sit: a parent other than itself, or the top. Refused, naming them, while live units would no longer fit; refused for a type an HRIS provides, and for a date before the types last changed. Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin.

parent_ids.description: level_ids this type can sit under
